text:
Anya: Quick heads up — Thistle's activation looks healthy overall but p95 token latency spiked from ~210ms ➜ ~410ms on 2024-11-03 14:12 UTC. Seeing higher tail on short prompts. Not urgent but renewal flagged this quarter, want to proactively reduce risk.
Jordan: thx for flagging. Any change in traffic shape or model version recently?
Anya: No model changes; traffic increased ~15% and prefix lengths are similar. Cost per 1k tokens up ~8% last 48h. Customer using hosted route -> model: redwood/large-v1 (fp16).
Priya: Probable KV cache churn + batching inefficiency. For short prompts, int8 quantized variant often helps latency and cost without major quality drop. Can we propose a canary to `redwood/large-v1-int8` + route to dedicated pool during canary?
Khalid: Customer is open to an optimization pilot. We should present a low-risk plan: 5% traffic canary for 72h, automated rollback if eval regressions >0.5% or p95 increases.
Jordan: Agree. From runtime side: int8 path uses different kernels. For Thistle traffic mix I'd also suggest prefix caching for repeated system prompts and a routing rule: prefer low-latency zone -> dedicated-lc1 for <50ms additional cost.
Anya: I'll draft the playbook. Priya — can you provide recommended eval prompts + expected quality delta range so Sales/AM can approve?
Priya: Sure. I'll run a small eval set (n=150) covering short customer prompts + edge cases. Expected BLEU-ish/semantic pass change <1-2% based on similar customers. I'll post results in this thread.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: canary=5%, duration=72h, metrics=[p95_latency,error_rate,semantic_quality], rollback_condition=quality_drop>0.5% OR p95>baseline*1.2
Khalid: Also propose a temporary routing hedge: if p95 during canary exceeds baseline*1.15, shift remaining traffic to `redwood/medium-v2-int8` until root cause triaged.
Anya: SGTM. Draft to customer: 1) 5% canary -> `large-v1-int8` w/ prefix cache on, 2) 72h monitoring window, 3) automatic rollback thresholds, 4) enable routing fallback to `medium-v2-int8`. Share approval window by EOD.
Jordan: Ops note — kernel warmup may show slight initial latency bump for first 100 reqs; consider warmup script:
```
# warmup
for i in range(200):
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/complete -d '{"model":"redwood/large-v1-int8","input":"hi"}' &>/dev/null
```
Priya: I'll attach the eval artifacts after run. Also recommend compressing embeddings for their embeddings route (if used) — reduces cost on embeddings-heavy calls.
Anya: Thanks team. Khalid, will you coordinate the customer approval and schedule the enablement walkthrough with Solutions (30m)?
Khalid: Yep, scheduling now. I'll ping Thistle and add calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Anya: Great — I'll update the playbook in Confluence and tag the customer in the approval note.
ops-bot: scheduled-deploy-window: 2024-11-05T09:00:00Z
Anya: putting a reminder to check reports 24h into canary. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
